scope: Idle full-AppModel callback intervals in deterministic mixed scenes. Not compositor presentation, pan/drag latency or save latency.
activation: Native fixture windows explicitly activated before completion; local edits and pan were exercised only after reports completed.
desktopLoad: No Canvas Cargo build during sampling; other desktop workloads were not controlled.
interruptedAttempt: Earlier 100-element attempt was archived in target/ and replaced by a fresh run after user resumed.
planningBudgetDefinition: p95 <=16.7 ms and p99 <=16.7 ms; this is not a maximum for every interval
